Reference3 established Lower Post interior/Ossa. Reference4 Ossa/Pell exact faces only, exclude historical bread/black offer. CURRENT STATE: work succeeded. Aren dark-navy hair, ivory short jacket/black outfit, old LEFT elbow tear and lower-hem tear, RIGHT sleeve intact. UPPER panel48: From inside the familiar postal hall, a medium three-quarter view joins the actual sorting table to a nearby OPEN stair window. Pell lays his old, slightly yellowed folded maintenance COPY beside Sera's distinct NEW white local survey work order. Each is one ordinary sheet, not the petition/official reply. Avoid text; their paper shapes and the later dialogue carry meaning. Pell points with his free hand through the open window toward ONE SMALL steady cyan ROUTE BEACON fixed to the adjacent iron lift structure outside. Sera, face visible beside him, studies that actual lamp and the new local safety-survey paper with focused practical interest. Her closed ledger nearby. The lamp is plainly visible in daylight, a small cyan glass working lamp, not a floating orb/hologram or a weapon beam. Show enough window frame and nearby lift hardware for a credible local sightline. No creature near lamp. Do NOT show supply wiring repair, hidden villain, sabotage or explanation of its cause. At table edge, Aren/Ossa may listen quietly; empty gray bag stays detached, harness stays Aren.
LOWER panel49: A tall exterior view from just outside the same Lower Post warm window. In the close foreground window, Aren, Ossa, Pell and Sera bend over those real work papers around their wooden sorting table, four distinct known adults in a small warm pool of light. Aren's current loose harness and retained clothes visible at this scale; no sword in hands. The previously reopened iron postal entrance below remains OPEN and usable, attached to continuous supported stairs, ordinary residents nearby. The NEIGHBORING lift tower in middle distance carries the SAME SMALL steadily lit cyan lamp. Behind, an immense layered blue Gothic city remains inhabited with balconies/windows and calm daylight atmosphere. Their one registered postal route reads as a modest warm place within it, not the whole city magically lighting up. No creatures, battle, magic connection lines, district-wide victory, future closure-order clue, keys or official petition reply. The next local survey is an invitation to investigate after the morning post, not a resolved mystery. Preserve the warm table as the emotional anchor and let architecture form large clear shapes rather than overwhelming the people with crack texture.
